description: Defines classes and methods for handling MPEG sections and tables, including validation, data access, and management of MPEG section data structures.

classes.name: Section
classes.description: Represents an MPEG section with methods for validation, data access, and extracting section-specific information.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: Manages a collection of MPEG sections, providing validation, addition, and storage functionalities.

methods.name: Section::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the MPEG section is valid based on size and CRC.

methods.name: Section::TableId
methods.description: Returns the table ID of the section.

methods.name: Section::HasSectionSyntax
methods.description: Indicates if the section has syntax.

methods.name: Section::Length
methods.description: Returns the length of the section.

methods.name: Section::Extension
methods.description: Returns the extension value if section has syntax.

methods.name: Section::Version
methods.description: Returns the version number if section has syntax.

methods.name: Section::IsCurrent
methods.description: Indicates if the section is current.

methods.name: Section::IsNext
methods.description: Indicates if the section is the next one.

methods.name: Section::SectionNumber
methods.description: Returns the section number.

methods.name: Section::LastSectionNumber
methods.description: Returns the last section number.

methods.name: Section::Hash
methods.description: Computes a hash value for the section.

methods.name: Section::Data
methods.description: Returns the data element of the section.

methods.name: Section::GetNumber
methods.description: Template method to get a number from the section data at a specific offset.

methods.name: Section::ValidCRC
methods.description: Validates the CRC of the section.

methods.name: Table::Storage
methods.description: Stores new data into the table, resetting current state.

methods.name: Table::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the table is valid based on section count.

methods.name: Table::TableId
methods.description: Returns the table ID.

methods.name: Table::Extension
methods.description: Returns the extension value.

methods.name: Table::GetNumber
methods.description: Template method to get a number from the table data at a specific offset.

methods.name: Table::Clear
methods.description: Clears the table data and resets state.

methods.name: Table::Data
methods.description: Returns the data element of the table.

methods.name: Table::AddSection
methods.description: Adds a section to the table if valid, managing internal storage and consistency.

methods.name: Table::Insert
methods.description: Inserts data into the table at a specified offset, resizing as needed.
